title: UI/UX Enhancement & Design System Audit
description: Comprehensive UI/UX analysis and enhancement of the AI Caddy Pro golf caddy application. Includes design system audit, spacing consistency, color theme adherence, typography hierarchy, and component visual consistency improvements.

phases.name: Analysis & Design System Audit
phases.description: Analyze current UI state, document findings from screenshots, audit design token usage across all components and screens

subtasks.title: Fix Critical Token System Issue
subtasks.description: The tokens.ts file is missing darkTokens, lightTokens, and Tokens type exports that ThemeProvider.tsx requires. Add complete themed token definitions including colors, spacing, shadows, gradients, and glow effects for both dark and light modes.
acceptance_criteria: darkTokens object exported with all required color tokens
lightTokens object exported with all required color tokens
Tokens type exported for type safety

All tokens include: colors (background, surface, surfaceAlt, surfaceGlass, textPrimary, textMuted, brand, brandAlt, border, shadow, danger, success, glowPrimary, glowSecondary, dangerGlow, successGlow), gradients (primary, surface), shadow definitions (subtle, card, glow), animation spring config
subtasks.notes: Token system now exports darkTokens, lightTokens, Tokens type, and tokens (default alias). All themed colors (background, surface, surfaceAlt, surfaceGlass, textPrimary, textMuted, brand, brandAlt, border, shadow, danger, success, warning, info, glowPrimary, glowSecondary, dangerGlow, successGlow), gradients (primary, surface), shadow definitions (subtle, card, glow), and animation spring config are properly defined for both dark and light modes. TypeScript compiles without token-related errors.

subtasks.title: Audit Spacing Consistency Across Screens
subtasks.description: Document all spacing values used in the 4 main screens (Weather, Shot Calculator, Wind Calculator, Settings). Identify hard-coded pixel values vs. token-based spacing. Create findings report.
subtasks.notes: Comprehensive spacing audit completed. Key findings: 127 total spacing declarations with only 19% token adoption rate. Identified 15+ instances of non-standard 12px gap value needing new token. Found hardcoded color in Settings (line 547). Touch targets using 44px instead of recommended 48px. Recommendations documented including Priority 1 (critical), Priority 2 (high), Priority 3 (medium), and Priority 4 (low) items.

subtasks.title: Audit Typography Usage
subtasks.description: Document typography styles across all screens. Identify inconsistencies in font sizes, weights, and line heights. Compare against typography.ts presets.
subtasks.notes: Typography audit complete. Key findings: 88% of typography uses scaling functions (78% safeScaledFontSize, 10% deprecated scaledFontSize). 0% typography.ts preset adoption despite 9 well-defined presets. Non-standard font sizes identified: 13px (5 uses), 15px (6 uses), 17px (1), 22px (1), 26px (1), 48px (1), 56px (1). Missing token: fontWeight.extrabold (800). Two files use deprecated scaledFontSize(): PrimaryRecommendation.tsx and EffectsGrid.tsx. Recommendations documented for token additions and preset adoption.

subtasks.title: Audit Color Token Usage
subtasks.description: Document all color values used across components and screens. Identify any inline hex colors that should use tokens. Verify theme switching compatibility.
subtasks.notes: Color audit complete. Key findings: 78% token adoption rate, 17 inline hex colors found, 8 theme-incompatible patterns identified. Critical fixes needed for button.tsx (#FFFFFF), settings/screen.tsx (#fff and rgba). Recommended 6 new token categories: onBrand, onDanger, overlay, overlayLight, ripple, and offline state colors. Full audit documented in color-audit-report.md with detailed verification checklist and priority-ordered remediation plan.
